notes: A hunger-games arena where twelve tributes fight until one is left is battle royale, which the index files under Shooter, and Shooter is the only genre that can express the two things such a map is made of - a contracting play boundary and weapons scavenged from the world; Survival is named second for the wilderness-and-scarcity half. It was close, and the choice is about vocabulary rather than firearms: the prompt names no guns, so the loot should be read as bows, blades and packs. open-battlefield is the preset's shape and the right one - one contiguous arena with dispersed points of interest, not lanes - and terrain-relief carries the New Zealand landform of hills, ridges and valleys that is the whole reason the setting was named, which costs tiered elevation and nothing more. building-interior was dropped from the preset because the answers ask for wilderness, so there is nothing to go inside and no P3. Decided without a user: the twelve start positions are read as one exposed ring of pedestals rather than shielded spawns, which is why no spawn option is taken, and the round ending on the last tribute standing is what the shrinking boundary drives toward.
